name: Document Maker
description: Generates and modifies PDF/HTML documents from templates or raw HTML using Playwright.

commands.generate_pdf: Converts HTML content to a PDF file and returns the file path.
commands.list_documents: Lists all documents in the documents folder.
commands.list_images: Lists available images in media/images and media/generated_photos that can be reused in documents.
commands.modify_document: Modifies an existing HTML document (add images, replace sections, change layout).
commands.optimize_layout: Calculates page breaks for a document and returns a report of elements split across pages.

function.name: DOCS__generate_pdf
function.description: Generates a PDF and HTML document from a template ID or raw HTML. Returns the absolute path of the generated files. IMPORTANT GUIDELINES: - Formatting: When writing raw HTML, you MUST include complete inline CSS (e.g. `body { margin: 0; padding: 20px; font-family: sans-serif; } * { box-sizing: border-box; }`) to ensure the PDF layout is correct and borders work. - Images: Use `` to include images. Images are stored in `media/images`. - Workflow: You can reuse previously generated images without calling the image generator again. ONLY generate new images if the user explicitly asks for them or if they don't exist. NEVER stop after image generation; always proceed to call this tool to finish the document. If Playwright/Chromium is unavailable, the HTML version will still be saved successfully.

html_content.description: Optional: Raw HTML content to convert to a document. Use for generated images. If provided, template_id is ignored.

template_id.description: Optional: The ID or name of an existing template from the Templates library (e.g. 'rivista_glamour_6_foto_editoriale', 'fotoromanzo_classico_4_foto_con_didascalia', 'doc-report-editorial-001', 'doc-report-executive-001', 'doc-letter-formal-001', 'doc-invoice-premium-001'). If omitted, freeform html_content or the default configured template is used.

template_vars.description: REQUIRED when using template_id. A JSON string with ALL template variables populated with REAL content you write. Example: '{"company": "Acme Corp", "report_title": "Q3 Report", "executive_summary": "This quarter we achieved..."}'. You MUST fill in every variable with actual text — do NOT leave placeholders or empty strings. The template will reject the call if variables are missing. IF YOU GENERATED IMAGES, YOU MUST EMBED THEM INSIDE CONTENT VARIABLES (e.g. section1_content) using ``.

filename.description: Optional: Desired name for the output file (e.g. 'magazine.pdf'). If not provided, a random UUID name will be used.

function.name: DOCS__list_documents
function.description: Lists all documents in the documents folder with their size and a content preview. Use this BEFORE modify_document to find the correct file path and understand the document structure.

search.description: Optional: Search term to filter documents by filename (e.g. 'jun' or 'fotoromanzo').

function.name: DOCS__modify_document
function.description:
Modifies an existing HTML document in media/documents. The PDF is automatically regenerated after modification.

Use this when the user asks to:
- Add missing photos to an existing document
- Change the layout (e.g. from 2 to 3 columns)
- Replace or update a section of text
- Append new content to a document

TIP: Call DOCS__list_documents first to find the document and understand its structure.

file_path.description: Path or filename of the document to modify. Can be a full path, a filename (e.g. 'jun_magic_preview.html'), or a partial name (e.g. 'jun_magic').

operation.description: The modification operation: 'add_images' (insert images into gallery or at placeholder), 'replace_section' (replace element by CSS selector), 'change_layout' (inject CSS rules), 'append' (add before </body>), 'patch' (find-and-replace text).

content.description: The HTML content, tags, or CSS rules to inject depending on the operation.

target_selector.description: Optional: For 'replace_section' a CSS selector (e.g. '.gallery', '#section2'). For 'patch' the exact text to find. For 'add_images' an optional placeholder text to replace with images.

function.name: DOCS__optimize_layout
function.description: Calculates page breaks for a document and returns a report of elements split across pages. Used to analyze pagination and determine where manual page breaks are needed.

document_id.description: The ID or filename of the document to optimize (e.g. 'magazine.html').

function.name: DOCS__list_images
function.description: Lists available images in media/images, media/generated_photos, or any specified folder. Call this before generating a document when the user asks to use existing photos, check the last generated photos, or pick random photos without regenerating them.

folder.description: Optional: subfolder name or path (e.g. 'images', 'generated_photos'). Defaults to scanning media images.

limit.description: Optional: number of images to return (default 10, max 50).

sort.description: Optional: 'recent' (default, newest first), 'random' (pick random images), 'oldest', or 'name'.

random_pick.description: Optional: set true to pick random images instead of recent ones.
